order: Add continuous integration running the review-lane suite, tests/review-lane.test.js, on Linux, Windows, and macOS across three supported runtime majors, for every push and pull request. Windows is the reason this job exists at all — every field failure in this lane has happened there, the suite exited 0 even with failing cases, and no session on this repo runs Windows. Fix in the same change the two Windows facts the matrix forces open — the runner cannot CreateProcess a .js file, so the tests hand it a .cmd shim, while kill('SIGTERM') there is TerminateProcess, so the honest expectation there is SIGKILL. Every leg of the matrix has to run to completion and report its own result; a red leg may never cancel or hide the others, since seeing which platforms disagree is the whole point. No build, bundle or publish step, nor any linter job or new dependency — only the runtime and git already on the box.
claims: Order fulfilled exactly as written, with the workflow at .github/workflows/test.yml running the review-lane suite on ubuntu-latest, windows-latest and macos-latest across runtimes 20, 22 and 24, on push, pull_request and manual dispatch. Every leg runs to completion and reports its own result, so a run shows which platforms disagree, and no failure ever cancels or hides another. No build, bundle or publish step, no linter job and no new dependency — the job needs only the runtime and git. The Windows shim and the SIGKILL expectation are both in the suite.
